methods.name: Headless arrows
methods.note: Feathers on arrow shafts, both stackable and sold in shops, so it trains anywhere. Quests can skip to 18 or 30. Feeds later arrows.

methods.name: Arrows (bronze to mithril tips)
methods.note: Arrowtips on headless arrows, 15 an action. Ironmen buy the tips from shops. Rates assume the headless arrows are already made.

methods.name: Unstrung bows
methods.note: Knife on logs, best bow for your level, 1,800 an hour. A fletching knife from Vale Totems makes it 2,700 an hour for 50% more xp.

methods.name: Stringing bows
methods.note: Bow strings on bought unstrung bows, 14 an inventory, 2,450 an hour. Usually cheap or profitable. A bow string spool adds about 3%.

methods.name: Darts
methods.note: Feathers on bought dart tips, two clicks a set, done while running or during other training. Mithril, adamant and amethyst are usual.

methods.name: Vale Totems
methods.note: Carve and decorate eight totems in Auburn Valley with bows fletched on the run. Rates need a log basket. Far more xp per log than bows.

methods.name: Iron darts (own dart tips)
methods.note: Smith iron bars into dart tips and feather them. Trains Mining, Smithing and Fletching together until broad arrows at 52.

methods.name: Battlestaves from celastrus bark
methods.note: Knife on celastrus bark for 80 xp each. Beats bows from 40 to 80 but can cost more. 143k an hour with a fletching knife.

methods.name: Broad arrows
methods.note: Needs the Broader Fletching unlock, 300 Slayer points. Arrowheads from any Slayer master. 450k an hour if headless arrows are premade.

methods.name: Maple longbows (u), Miscellania logs
methods.note: Maple logs from Managing Miscellania cut into longbows. About 150k an hour with a fletching knife. Strung, they alch for 384 each.

methods.name: Arrows (adamant to dragon tips)
methods.note: Bought arrowtips on headless arrows, 3,000 actions an hour, done between other activities. Assumes headless arrows are already made.

methods.name: Redwood shields
methods.note: Two redwood logs a shield for 216 xp, minimal attention. 193k an hour with a fletching knife.

unverified: Darts: the main guide gives XP per dart (Template:Table/Fletching/Darts, fetched) but no hourly rate; bands are XP per dart x 18,000 darts an hour, the realistic figure in the Ironman Guide, so they are derived not quoted

Vale Totems: bands are computed from the guide's own formulas for a full eight-totem loop with a plain knife and unstrung bows (270 s loop); the guide says yew and above are lower in practice because of totem reset downtime; partial loops without a log basket are about 20% lower
Vale Totems: the Ironman Guide gives different averaged figures with a log basket (oak 29,000, willow 71,000, maple 120,000, yew 225,000, magic 340,000, redwood 420,000)
Vale Totems: the magic longbow (u) row at 85 has an inconsistent XP/h formula in the wikitext (works out lower than magic shortbow), so no band was added at 85
Vale Totems: req uses the miniquest page title 'Vale Totems (miniquest)'; a quest tracker may list it under a different key

Broad arrows: needs the Broader Fletching Slayer unlock (300 points), which the req syntax cannot express; 247,500 is the guide's rate including making the headless arrows, 450,000 if they are premade
Arrows (both entries): rates assume 3,000 actions an hour with headless arrows already made
Maple longbows (u), Miscellania logs: the Throne of Miscellania requirement comes from the Managing Miscellania page, not the fletching guide
Arrows (adamant to dragon tips), Stringing bows, Unstrung bows, Redwood shields: cost is a judgement call because GP/XP columns are live GE price templates
Omitted: bolts and tipped bolts (zero-time alternatives the guide rates below darts), Wintertodt kindling passive xp (210 to 21,000/h, not a training method), Trouble Brewing (marked obsolete)
